en.headline: Patient arrested after bedding and restraint belts set ablaze at Kwong Wah Hospital
en.dek: A 25-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of arson after a fire broke out at the Yau Ma Tei hospital in the early hours of Sunday; no injuries were reported.
body: Police arrested a 25-year-old man surnamed Wong on suspicion of arson after bedding and restraint belts were set alight at Kwong Wah Hospital in Yau Ma Tei early on Sunday. No injuries were reported.

Security staff alerted police at about 12:36 a.m. after a male patient allegedly ignited the items. The Fire Services Department responded and, after a preliminary investigation, classified the blaze as suspicious. The fire was extinguished without further damage.

The man remained in custody pending further investigation. The case is being handled by the Yau Tsim District Criminal Investigation Team. Arson carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment under Hong Kong law.

zh.headline: 廣華醫院病人點燃約束帶及床墊 25歲男子涉縱火被捕
zh.dek: 周日凌晨油麻地廣華醫院發生可疑火警，一名25歲姓黃男病人涉嫌點燃約束帶及床墊，無人受傷，已被警方拘捕。
body: 警方拘捕一名25歲姓黃男子，涉嫌於周日凌晨在油麻地廣華醫院點燃約束帶及床墊。事件無人受傷。
約凌晨12時36分，醫院保安報案指一名男病人點燃雜物。消防到場後初步調查認為起火原因可疑，火勢已被撲熄。
黃男正被扣留調查，案件由油尖警區刑事調查隊跟進。根據香港法例，縱火罪最高可判終身監禁。
